verses.text: Give unto the LORD|strong="H3068" , O ye mighty, give unto the LORD|strong="H3068" glory and strength.
Give unto the LORD|strong="H3068" the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD|strong="H3068" in the beauty of holiness.
The voice of the LORD|strong="H3068" is* upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD|strong="H3068" is* upon many waters.
The voice of the LORD|strong="H3068" is* powerful; the voice of the LORD|strong="H3068" is* full of majesty.
The voice of the LORD|strong="H3068" breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD|strong="H3068" breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
The voice of the LORD|strong="H3068" divideth the flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD|strong="H3068" shaketh the wilderness; the LORD|strong="H3068" shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the LORD|strong="H3068" maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his* glory.
The LORD|strong="H3068" sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD|strong="H3068" sitteth King for ever.
The LORD|strong="H3068" will give strength unto his people; the LORD|strong="H3068" will bless his people with peace.
